tours.name: Post and Discover Clip
tours.outcome: Clip is published to the feed and visible on creator profile for discovery

steps.title: Upload short clip with caption (the clip becomes published). Rule: Clip must include video file and valid caption
Scroll feed and view published clips. Rule: Only visible, non-hidden clips appear in feed

tours.name: Engage with Content and Creators
tours.outcome: Social interactions are recorded and target member is notified

steps.title: Like a clip (the like becomes active). Rule: A member can like a clip once
Post comment or reply on clip (the comment becomes published). Rule: Comment cannot be empty
Follow creator (the follow becomes active). Rule: A member cannot follow themselves
Receive interaction notification (the notification becomes delivered). Rule: Trigger notification on like, reply, or new follow

tours.name: Report and Moderate Content
tours.outcome: Violating content is hidden from community view

steps.title: Report clip or comment (the report becomes pending). Rule: Report must specify reason
Review report in moderation queue (the report becomes under_review)
Hide violating content (the clip becomes hidden). Rule: Content breaking rules must be hidden from feed and profile
